digest.component_or_area: Rebar LLM Agent — Pydantic boundary and usage accounting
propositions: Successful Agent runs with multiple retries must report aggregate usage (sum of all attempts) in memory, telemetry, and exactly one JSONL row, not per-attempt rows.

Validation-failure exhaustion must re-raise the identical original Rebar StructuredOutputError by walking the UnexpectedModelBehavior cause chain; repeated-truncation exhaustion (where no Rebar object exists in the chain) must construct a fresh UnretryableOutputError.

Terminal failure must preserve consumed requests and tokens without creating fictional usage for calls that reported none, and store only the complete final provider response when artifact capture is enabled.

Existing pricing, historical rows, and usage schema remain compatible because no new core usage field (like candidate_requests) is introduced, only higher aggregated counters after successful retries.
Unrelated UnexpectedModelBehavior exceptions (lacking the 'Exceeded maximum output retries' marker) must pass through unchanged without cause-chain translation.
